## Mendelian randomization for Loneliness -> Triglycerides, Loneliness -> Depression and Triglycerides -> Depression

Primary analyses: PanUKB loneliness → triglycerides → depression. AoU loneliness is a sensitivity exposure. The pairwise analyses below estimate each link; they do not, by themselves, estimate a formal indirect/mediation effect.

Notes:
- everything should be Hg38 build for coordinates, so make sure plink build is correct
- 

### Setup and paths


### Read and standardize summary statistics

The AoU file uses `CHROM`, `GENPOS`, `ID`, `ALLELE0`, `ALLELE1`, `N`, `TEST`, `BETA`, `SE`, and `LOG10P`. The additive (`ADD`) rows are retained; `ALLELE1` is treated as the effect allele for `BETA`, and `ALLELE0` as the other allele. Confirm that allele convention against the AoU export documentation before interpreting direction.

Other files are expected to have the standardized columns `SNP`, `A1`, `A2`, `BETA`, `SE`, `P`, and `N` (with optional `CHR`, `BP`, `EAF`).

```{r readers, include=FALSE, cache=TRUE}
read_aou <- function(path) {
  x <- fread(path)
  required <- c("CHROM", "GENPOS", "ID", "ALLELE0", "ALLELE1", "N",
                "TEST", "BETA", "SE", "LOG10P")
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(x))
  if (length(missing)) stop("AoU file is missing columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

  if (!"ADD" %in% x$TEST) stop("No TEST == 'ADD' records found in AoU file.")
  x <- x[TEST == "ADD", .(
    SNP = as.character(ID),
    CHR = as.character(CHROM),
    BP = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(GENPOS)),
    A1 = toupper(as.character(ALLELE1)),
    A2 = toupper(as.character(ALLELE0)),
    BETA = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(BETA)),
    SE = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(SE)),
    # Keep extremely small p-values positive instead of underflowing to zero.
    P = pmax(10^(-suppressWarnings(as.numeric(LOG10P))), .Machine$double.xmin),
    N = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(N))
  )]
  validate_sumstats(x, "AoU loneliness")
}

validate_sumstats <- function(x, label) {
  req <- c("SNP", "A1", "A2", "BETA", "SE", "P", "N")
  missing <- setdiff(req, names(x))
  if (length(missing)) stop(label, " missing standardized fields: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  x[, `:=`(
    SNP = as.character(SNP), A1 = toupper(as.character(A1)),
    A2 = toupper(as.character(A2)), BETA = as.numeric(BETA),
    SE = as.numeric(SE), P = as.numeric(P), N = as.numeric(N)
  )]
  x <- x[!is.na(SNP) & nzchar(SNP) &
           A1 %chin% c("A", "C", "G", "T") & A2 %chin% c("A", "C", "G", "T") &
           is.finite(BETA) & is.finite(SE) & SE > 0 &
           is.finite(P) & P > 0 & P <= 1 & is.finite(N) & N > 0]
  dup <- x[, .N, by = SNP][N > 1, SNP]
  if (length(dup)) {
    message(label, ": removing all records for ", length(dup), " duplicated SNP IDs")
    x <- x[!SNP %chin% dup]
  }
  if (!nrow(x)) stop("No usable variants remain for ", label)
  x
}

read_standard <- function(path, label) {
  x <- fread(path)
  # Accept either P or -log10(P), then standardize the common analysis fields.
  if (!"P" %in% names(x) && "LOG10P" %in% names(x)) x[, P := 10^(-as.numeric(LOG10P))]
  if (!"P" %in% names(x) && "NEG_LOG10_P" %in% names(x)) x[, P := 10^(-as.numeric(NEG_LOG10_P))]
  validate_sumstats(x, label)
}

read_trait <- function(path, label, is_aou = FALSE) {
  if (is_aou) read_aou(path) else read_standard(path, label)
}

traits <- list(
  aou_lonely = read_trait(PATH_AOU_LONELY, "AoU loneliness", TRUE),
  pan_lonely = read_trait(PATH_PAN_LONELY, "PanUKB loneliness"),
  tg = read_trait(PATH_TG, "Triglycerides"),
  depression = read_trait(PATH_DEPRESSION, "Depression"),
  t2d = read_trait(PATH_T2D, "Type 2 Diabetes")
)
vapply(traits, nrow, integer(1))
```

### TwoSampleMR
- Note, this uses a reduced thrshold of 5e-6 
- 5e-8 will be run as sensitivity analyses, but not many things survive

```{r twosamplemr helper functions, echo=FALSE}
to_tsmr <- function(x, type, trait_name) {
  if (!nrow(x)) stop("No variants to format for ", trait_name, " (", type, ").")
  d <- as.data.frame(x)
  d$trait_name <- trait_name
  TwoSampleMR::format_data(
    d, type = type, snp_col = "SNP", beta_col = "BETA", se_col = "SE",
    effect_allele_col = "A1", other_allele_col = "A2",
    pval_col = "P", phenotype_col = "trait_name"
  )
}

# helper function to specifically convert AoU CHR:BP to rsIDs
map_aou_to_rsid <- function(x) {
  x <- data.table::copy(data.table::as.data.table(x))

  required <- c("SNP", "CHR", "BP", "A1", "A2")
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(x))
  if (length(missing)) {
    stop("Missing columns for rsID mapping: ",
         paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }

  dbsnp <- SNPlocs.Hsapiens.dbSNP155.GRCh38
  available_seqnames <- GenomeInfoDb::seqlevels(dbsnp)

  chr <- sub("^chr", "", as.character(x$CHR), ignore.case = TRUE)
  bp <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(x$BP))

  # Match the chromosome naming convention used by the dbSNP package.
  seqname <- ifelse(
    chr %in% available_seqnames,
    chr,
    paste0("chr", chr)
  )

  valid <- is.finite(bp) & bp > 0 &
    seqname %in% available_seqnames &
    !is.na(x$A1) & !is.na(x$A2)

  rows <- which(valid)
  if (!length(rows)) {
    warning("No rows had usable chromosome and position values.")
    return(x)
  }

  query <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
    seqnames = seqname[rows],
    ranges = IRanges::IRanges(start = bp[rows], end = bp[rows])
  )

  snp_hits <- BSgenome::snpsByOverlaps(dbsnp, query)
  if (!length(snp_hits)) {
    warning("No coordinates matched the GRCh38 dbSNP annotation.")
    return(x)
  }

  overlaps <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(query, snp_hits, ignore.strand = TRUE)
  if (!length(overlaps)) {
    warning("No coordinate overlaps were returned by dbSNP.")
    return(x)
  }

  meta <- S4Vectors::mcols(snp_hits)
  rsid <- as.character(meta$RefSNP_id)
  rsid <- ifelse(grepl("^rs", rsid, ignore.case = TRUE), rsid,
                 paste0("rs", rsid))
  allele_code <- as.character(meta$alleles_as_ambig)

  # Decode IUPAC allele codes, e.g. R = A/G.
  iupac <- Biostrings::IUPAC_CODE_MAP

  decode_alleles <- function(code) {
    if (is.na(code) || !code %in% names(iupac)) return(character())
    strsplit(unname(iupac[code]), "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  }

  qh <- S4Vectors::queryHits(overlaps)
  sh <- S4Vectors::subjectHits(overlaps)

  matched <- vector("list", length(rows))

  for (k in seq_along(qh)) {
    i <- qh[k]                 # row within the query
    j <- sh[k]                 # matching dbSNP record
    db_alleles <- decode_alleles(allele_code[j])

    if (length(db_alleles) != 2L) next

    gwas_alleles <- toupper(c(x$A1[rows[i]], x$A2[rows[i]]))
    if (identical(sort(db_alleles), sort(gwas_alleles))) {
      matched[[i]] <- c(matched[[i]], rsid[j])
    }
  }

  # Assign an rsID only when exactly one distinct matching ID remains.
  mapped_n <- 0L
  for (i in seq_along(rows)) {
    ids <- unique(matched[[i]])
    if (length(ids) == 1L) {
      x$SNP[rows[i]] <- ids
      mapped_n <- mapped_n + 1L
    }
  }

  message("Mapped ", mapped_n, " of ", length(rows),
          " coordinate/allele records to unique rsIDs.")
  x
}

### uses 5e-6 threshold 
clump_exposure <- function(x, p_threshold = 5e-6) {
  x <- data.table::copy(data.table::as.data.table(x))

  iv <- x[is.finite(P) & P < p_threshold]
  message("Variants passing P < ", format(p_threshold), ": ", nrow(iv))

  if (!nrow(iv)) {
    stop("No variants pass the instrument p-value threshold.")
  }

  # The AoU exposure has coordinate-based IDs; map those candidates to rsIDs.
  if (any(!grepl("^rs[0-9]+$", iv$SNP, ignore.case = TRUE))) {
    iv <- map_aou_to_rsid(iv)
  }

  # PLINK can only clump variants represented in its .bim file.
  bim_path <- paste0(LD_BFILE, ".bim")
  if (!file.exists(bim_path)) {
    stop("PLINK .bim file not found: ", bim_path)
  }

  bim_ids <- data.table::fread(
    bim_path,
    select = 2L,
    header = FALSE,
    colClasses = "character"
  )[[1L]]

  iv <- iv[!is.na(SNP) & SNP %chin% bim_ids]
  message("Candidates with rsIDs present in PLINK panel: ", nrow(iv))

  if (!nrow(iv)) {
    stop("No candidate rsIDs are present in the PLINK reference panel.")
  }

  # Remove all records for any rsID duplicated after coordinate mapping.
  duplicate_ids <- iv[, .N, by = SNP][N > 1L, SNP]
  if (length(duplicate_ids)) {
    message("Dropping ", length(duplicate_ids),
            " duplicated rsIDs after mapping.")
    iv <- iv[!SNP %chin% duplicate_ids]
  }

  if (!nrow(iv)) {
    stop("No unique candidate variants remain for clumping.")
  }

  clumped <- ieugwasr::ld_clump_local(
    dat = data.frame(rsid = iv$SNP, pval = iv$P),
    clump_kb = 10000,
    clump_r2 = 0.001,
    clump_p = p_threshold,
    bfile = LD_BFILE,
    plink_bin = PLINK_BIN
  )

  if (is.null(clumped) || !nrow(clumped)) {
    stop("PLINK returned no clumped instruments.")
  }

  kept <- iv[SNP %chin% clumped$rsid]
  message("Independent instruments after clumping: ", nrow(kept))

  if (!nrow(kept)) {
    stop("No instruments remained after local LD clumping.")
  }

  kept
}

# clump exposure stringent
clump_exposure_stringent <- function(x, p_threshold = 5e-8) {
  x <- data.table::copy(data.table::as.data.table(x))

  iv <- x[is.finite(P) & P < p_threshold]
  message("Variants passing P < ", format(p_threshold), ": ", nrow(iv))

  if (!nrow(iv)) {
    stop("No variants pass the instrument p-value threshold.")
  }

  # The AoU exposure has coordinate-based IDs; map those candidates to rsIDs.
  if (any(!grepl("^rs[0-9]+$", iv$SNP, ignore.case = TRUE))) {
    iv <- map_aou_to_rsid(iv)
  }

  # PLINK can only clump variants represented in its .bim file.
  bim_path <- paste0(LD_BFILE, ".bim")
  if (!file.exists(bim_path)) {
    stop("PLINK .bim file not found: ", bim_path)
  }

  bim_ids <- data.table::fread(
    bim_path,
    select = 2L,
    header = FALSE,
    colClasses = "character"
  )[[1L]]

  iv <- iv[!is.na(SNP) & SNP %chin% bim_ids]
  message("Candidates with rsIDs present in PLINK panel: ", nrow(iv))

  if (!nrow(iv)) {
    stop("No candidate rsIDs are present in the PLINK reference panel.")
  }

  # Remove all records for any rsID duplicated after coordinate mapping.
  duplicate_ids <- iv[, .N, by = SNP][N > 1L, SNP]
  if (length(duplicate_ids)) {
    message("Dropping ", length(duplicate_ids),
            " duplicated rsIDs after mapping.")
    iv <- iv[!SNP %chin% duplicate_ids]
  }

  if (!nrow(iv)) {
    stop("No unique candidate variants remain for clumping.")
  }

  clumped <- ieugwasr::ld_clump_local(
    dat = data.frame(rsid = iv$SNP, pval = iv$P),
    clump_kb = 10000,
    clump_r2 = 0.001,
    clump_p = p_threshold,
    bfile = LD_BFILE,
    plink_bin = PLINK_BIN
  )

  if (is.null(clumped) || !nrow(clumped)) {
    stop("PLINK returned no clumped instruments.")
  }

  kept <- iv[SNP %chin% clumped$rsid]
  message("Independent instruments after clumping: ", nrow(kept))

  if (!nrow(kept)) {
    stop("No instruments remained after local LD clumping.")
  }

  kept
}

# relaxed 5e-6

run_tsmr_pair <- function(exposure, outcome, exposure_name, outcome_name) {
  exp_iv <- clump_exposure(exposure)
  exp_dat <- to_tsmr(exp_iv, "exposure", exposure_name)

  # First match IDs directly. If they differ, match variants by coordinates
  # and the unordered allele pair (requires the same genome build).
  outcome_rows <- outcome[SNP %chin% exp_iv$SNP]
  if (!nrow(outcome_rows) && all(c("CHR", "BP") %in% names(exp_iv)) &&
      all(c("CHR", "BP") %in% names(outcome))) {
    e <- copy(exp_iv)
    o <- copy(outcome)
    e[, `:=`(match_chr = sub("^chr", "", as.character(CHR), ignore.case = TRUE),
             match_bp = as.numeric(BP),
             allele_lo = pmin(A1, A2), allele_hi = pmax(A1, A2))]
    o[, `:=`(match_chr = sub("^chr", "", as.character(CHR), ignore.case = TRUE),
             match_bp = as.numeric(BP),
             allele_lo = pmin(A1, A2), allele_hi = pmax(A1, A2))]
    outcome_rows <- merge(
      o, unique(e[, .(match_chr, match_bp, allele_lo, allele_hi, SNP)]),
      by = c("match_chr", "match_bp", "allele_lo", "allele_hi"),
      all = FALSE, allow.cartesian = FALSE, suffixes = c("", "_exposure")
    )
    if (nrow(outcome_rows)) {
      outcome_rows[, SNP := SNP_exposure]
      outcome_rows[, SNP_exposure := NULL]
    }
  }
  if (!nrow(outcome_rows)) {
    warning("Skipping ", exposure_name, " -> ", outcome_name,
            ": none of the retained exposure instruments is present in the outcome by SNP ID or exact chromosome/position/alleles.")
    return(list(
      status = "skipped: no instrument overlap",
      harmonised = data.table(),
      mr = data.table(),
      heterogeneity = NULL,
      pleiotropy = NULL
    ))
  }

  out_dat <- to_tsmr(outcome_rows, "outcome", outcome_name)
  harm <- TwoSampleMR::harmonise_data(exp_dat, out_dat, action = 3)
  harm <- subset(harm, mr_keep)
  if (!nrow(harm)) stop("No harmonized instruments for ", exposure_name, " -> ", outcome_name)
  methods <- if (nrow(harm) == 1L) {
    "mr_wald_ratio"
  } else {
    c("mr_ivw", "mr_weighted_median", "mr_egger_regression")
  }
  list(
    status = "completed",
    harmonised = harm,
    mr = TwoSampleMR::mr(harm, method_list = methods),
    heterogeneity = if (nrow(harm) >= 2) TwoSampleMR::mr_heterogeneity(harm) else NULL,
    pleiotropy = if (nrow(harm) >= 3) TwoSampleMR::mr_pleiotropy_test(harm) else NULL
  )
}

# stringent 5e-8
```

#### Relaxed Threshold Two-Sample MR
- 5e-6
```{r run twosamplemr, include=FALSE, cache=TRUE}

# Aou loneliness -> Triglycerides
tsmr_aou_tg <- run_tsmr_pair(traits$aou_lonely, traits$tg, "AoU loneliness", "Triglycerides")

# Aou loneliness -> Depression
tsmr_aou_dep <- run_tsmr_pair(traits$aou_lonely, traits$depression, "AoU loneliness", "Depression")

# PanUKB Lonleiness -> Triglycerides
tsmr_pan_tg <- run_tsmr_pair(traits$pan_lonely, traits$tg, "PanUKB loneliness", "Triglycerides")

# PanUKB Loneliness -> Depression
tsmr_pan_dep <- run_tsmr_pair(traits$pan_lonely, traits$depression, "PanUKB loneliness", "Depression")


# Triglycericdes --> Depression
tsmr_tg_dep <- run_tsmr_pair(traits$tg, traits$depression, "Triglycerides", "Depression")

# Aou Loneliness -> T2D
tsmr_aou_t2d <-  run_tsmr_pair(traits$aou_lonely, traits$t2d, "AoU loneliness", "Type 2 Diabetes")

# PanUKB loneliness -> T2D
tsmr_pan_t2d <-  run_tsmr_pair(traits$pan_lonely, traits$t2d, "PanUKB loneliness", "Type 2 Diabetes")

# Triglyceriudes --> T2D
tsmr_tg_t2d <-  run_tsmr_pair(traits$tg, traits$t2d, "Triglycerides", "Type 2 Diabetes")

# bind results together
tsmr_results <- rbindlist(list(
  tsmr_aou_tg$mr, tsmr_aou_dep$mr, tsmr_pan_tg$mr,
  tsmr_pan_dep$mr, tsmr_tg_dep$mr, tsmr_aou_t2d$mr, 
  tsmr_pan_t2d$mr, tsmr_tg_t2d$mr
), fill = TRUE)
fwrite(tsmr_results, file.path(OUT_DIR, "twosamplemr_results.csv"))
tsmr_status <- data.table(
  analysis = c("AoU loneliness -> Triglycerides", 
               "AoU loneliness -> Depression",
               "PanUKB loneliness -> Triglycerides", 
               "PanUKB loneliness -> Depression",
               "Triglycerides -> Depression",
               "AoU loneliness -> Type 2 Diabetes",
               "PanUKB loneliness -> Type 2 Diabetes",
               "Triglycerides -> Type 2 Diabetes"),
  status = vapply(list(tsmr_aou_tg, tsmr_aou_dep, tsmr_pan_tg,
                       tsmr_pan_dep, tsmr_tg_dep, tsmr_aou_t2d, 
                       tsmr_pan_t2d, tsmr_tg_t2d ), `[[`, character(1), "status")
)
fwrite(tsmr_status, file.path(OUT_DIR, "twosamplemr_status.csv"))
```


#### Check Mapping Issues
- with AoU Chr:BP specifically

```{r mapping issues, echo=FALSE}
library(data.table)

# Apply the same significance threshold used by clump_exposure().
candidates <- traits$aou_lonely[is.finite(P) & P < 5e-6]

# Map AoU coordinate IDs to GRCh38 dbSNP rsIDs.
mapped <- map_aou_to_rsid(candidates)

bim_ids <- fread(
  paste0(LD_BFILE, ".bim"),
  select = 2L,
  header = FALSE,
  colClasses = "character"
)[[1L]]

cat("Significant candidates:", nrow(candidates), "\n")
cat("Candidates mapped to rsIDs:", sum(grepl("^rs[0-9]+$", mapped$SNP)), "\n")
cat("Unique rsIDs in BIM:", uniqueN(bim_ids), "\n")
cat("Mapped rsIDs present in BIM:",
    sum(unique(mapped$SNP) %chin% unique(bim_ids)), "\n")

cat("\nExample mapped IDs:\n")
print(head(mapped$SNP, 10))

cat("\nExample BIM IDs:\n")
print(head(bim_ids, 10))

cat("\nMapped IDs not found in BIM:\n")
print(head(setdiff(unique(mapped$SNP), unique(bim_ids)), 10))
```

```{r debugging Hg38 mapping, include=FALSE}
library(GenomicRanges)
library(IRanges)
library(GenomeInfoDb)
library(SNPlocs.Hsapiens.dbSNP155.GRCh38)

dbsnp <- SNPlocs.Hsapiens.dbSNP155.GRCh38
available_seqnames <- GenomeInfoDb::seqlevels(dbsnp)

chr <- as.character(candidates$CHR[1])
seqname <- if (chr %in% available_seqnames) {
  chr
} else if (paste0("chr", chr) %in% available_seqnames) {
  paste0("chr", chr)
} else {
  stop("Chromosome not found in dbSNP annotation: ", chr)
}

query <- GRanges(
  seqnames = seqname,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = as.integer(candidates$BP[1]),
    end = as.integer(candidates$BP[1])
  )
)

hits <- BSgenome::snpsByOverlaps(dbsnp, query)

cat("Annotation chromosome style:", seqname, "\n")
cat("Hits at this position:", length(hits), "\n")
if (length(hits)) {
  print(as.data.frame(hits))
}
```

#### Summary
- with relaxed threshold (5e-6), IVW and MW estimates with 8 SNPs find loneliness (PanUKB) -> depression (beta_IVW = 0.226, p = 0.03)
- loneliness (PanUKB) -> T2D WM with 10 SNPs estimate only significant (beta_WM = 0.143, p = 0.006)
- Triglycerides -> T2D all significant (beta_IVW = 0.342, p < 0.0001)

- **so overall, there is no evidence of causal associations between loneliness and triglycerides, and there is weak evidence of causal associations of loneliness -> T2D, and strong evidence of triglycerides -> T2D**

#### Bidirectional MR
- we tested loneliness -> triglycerides, loneliness -> depression/T2D and triglycerides -> depression/T2D
- now we can test 
a) depression -> triglycerides, depression -> loneliness, triglycerides -> loneliness
b) T2D -> triglycerides, T2D -> loneliness

```{r run bidirectional mr pairs, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE}
tsmr_tg_aou <- run_tsmr_pair(traits$tg, traits$aou_lonely, "Triglycerides", "AoU loneliness")
tsmr_dep_aou <- run_tsmr_pair(traits$depression, traits$aou_lonely, "Depression", "AoU loneliness")
tsmr_tg_pan <- run_tsmr_pair(traits$tg, traits$pan_lonely, "Triglycerides", "PanUKB loneliness")
tsmr_dep_pan <- run_tsmr_pair(traits$depression, traits$pan_lonely, "Depression", "PanUKB loneliness")
tsmr_dep_tg <- run_tsmr_pair(traits$depression, traits$tg, "Depression", "Triglycerides")
tsmr_t2d_aou <-  run_tsmr_pair(traits$t2d, traits$aou_lonely, "Type 2 Diabetes", "AoU loneliness")
tsmr_t2d_pan <-  run_tsmr_pair(traits$t2d, traits$pan_lonely, "Type 2 Diabetes", "PanUKB loneliness")
tsmr_t2d_tg <-  run_tsmr_pair(traits$t2d, traits$tg, "Type 2 Diabetes", "Triglycerides")


tsmr_results_reverse <- rbindlist(list(
  tsmr_tg_aou$mr, tsmr_dep_aou$mr, tsmr_tg_pan$mr,
  tsmr_dep_pan$mr, tsmr_dep_tg$mr, tsmr_t2d_aou$mr, 
  tsmr_t2d_pan$mr, tsmr_t2d_tg$mr
), fill = TRUE)
fwrite(tsmr_results_reverse, file.path(OUT_DIR, "twosamplemr_results_reverse.csv"))
tsmr_status_reverse <- data.table(
  analysis = c("Triglycerides -> loneliness", 
               "Depression -> AoU loneliness",
               "Triglycerides -> PanUKB loneliness", 
               "Depression -> PanUKB loneliness",
               "Depression -> Triglycerides",
               "Type 2 Diabetes -> AoU loneliness",
               "Type 2 Diabetes -> PanUKB loneliness",
               "Type 2 Diabetes -> Triglycerides"),
  status = vapply(list(tsmr_tg_aou, tsmr_dep_aou, tsmr_tg_pan,
                       tsmr_dep_pan, tsmr_dep_tg, tsmr_t2d_aou, 
                       tsmr_t2d_pan, tsmr_t2d_tg ), `[[`, character(1), "status")
)
fwrite(tsmr_status_reverse, file.path(OUT_DIR, "twosamplemr_status_reverse.csv"))
```

- evidence of Triglycerides -> PanUKB loneliness, consistent across IVW and WM (beta IVW = 0.078, p < 0.001, nSNPS = 485).
- evidence of Depression -> PanUKB Loneliness, consistent across all MR methods (beta IVW = 0.477, p < 0.001, nSNPS = 131)
- evidence of Depression -> Triglycerides -> consistent across IVW and WM (beta IVW = 0.156, p = 0.004, nSNPS = 60)
- weak evidence of T2D -> AoU Loneliness only WM (beta WM = 0.72, p = 0.04, nSNPS = 6)
- weak evidence of T2D -> PanUKB Loneliness only IVW (beta IVW = 0.035, p = 0.002, nSNPS = 395)
- evidence of T2D -> Triglycerides, consistent across IVW and WM (beta IVW = 0.114, p < 0.001, nSNPS = 186)

**so it looks like there is more evidence of an effect of T2D -> Triglycerides -> Loneliness, suggesting that immune vulnerability may cause loneliness, partly mediated through immune biomarkers**

```{r forest plot, echo=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

plot_data <- rbindlist(
  list(
    as.data.table(tsmr_results)[, direction := "Forward"],
    as.data.table(tsmr_results_reverse)[, direction := "Reverse"]
  ),
  fill = TRUE
)

# Exclude AoU loneliness sensitivity comparisons.
plot_data <- plot_data[
  !grepl("AoU", exposure, ignore.case = TRUE) &
    !grepl("AoU", outcome, ignore.case = TRUE)
]

plot_data <- plot_data[
  is.finite(b) & is.finite(se) & se >= 0
]

plot_data[, `:=`(
  ci_low = b - 1.96 * se,
  ci_high = b + 1.96 * se,
  analysis = paste(exposure, "\u2192", outcome)
)]

#plot_data <- plot_data[
#  !grepl("egger|wald ratio", method, ignore.case = TRUE)

# Keep rows grouped by direction and exposure/outcome.

p_mr_forest <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = b, y = analysis, color = method)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high),
    height = 0.18,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.65)

  geom_point(
    size = 2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.65)

    color = "MR method",

    subtitle = "Including AoU Loneliness as Sensitivity"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_mr_forest
```

```{r mr-sensitivity, include=FALSE, cache=TRUE}
# Continuous-trait pairs are suitable candidates for Steiger checks.
# Depression and T2D excluded because they are binary traits.
steiger_pairs <- c(
  "aou_to_tg", "panukb_to_tg",
  "tg_to_aou", "tg_to_panukb"
)

steiger_pairs_stringent <- c(
  "aou_to_tg_stringent", "panukb_to_tg_stringent",
  "tg_to_aou_stringent", "tg_to_panukb_stringent"
)

safe_test <- function(fun, dat, comparison, ...) {
  tryCatch({
    result <- data.table::as.data.table(fun(dat, ...))
    if (nrow(result)) result[, comparison := comparison]
    result
  }, error = function(e) {
    data.table::data.table(
      comparison = comparison,
      error = conditionMessage(e)
    )
  })
}

run_pair_sensitivity <- function(result, comparison) {
  if (is.null(result$harmonised) || !nrow(result$harmonised)) {
    empty <- data.table::data.table(
      comparison = comparison,
      error = "No harmonized SNP data available"
    )
    return(list(
      strength = empty,
      estimates = empty,
      heterogeneity = empty,
      egger_intercept = empty,
      leave_one_out = empty,
      single_snp = empty,
      steiger = empty
    ))
  }

  # Harmonized variants retained by run_tsmr_pair().
  dat <- as.data.frame(result$harmonised)
  n_snps <- nrow(dat)

  # Approximate per-variant instrument F statistics: (beta / SE)^2.
  strength <- data.table::data.table(comparison = comparison, n_snps = n_snps)
  if (all(c("beta.exposure", "se.exposure") %in% names(dat))) {
    f_stat <- (dat$beta.exposure / dat$se.exposure)^2
    f_stat <- f_stat[is.finite(f_stat)]

    strength[, `:=`(
      mean_F = if (length(f_stat)) mean(f_stat) else NA_real_,
      min_F = if (length(f_stat)) min(f_stat) else NA_real_,
      n_F_below_10 = sum(f_stat < 10)
    )]
  } else {
    strength[, error := "Missing beta.exposure or se.exposure"]
  }

  # Compare IVW with robust estimators and retain MR-Egger as a sensitivity estimate even if you choose not to show it in the main forest plot.
  methods <- c(
    "mr_ivw",
    "mr_weighted_median",
    "mr_weighted_mode",
    "mr_egger_regression"
  )

  estimates <- data.table::rbindlist(
    lapply(methods, function(method) {
      safe_test(
        TwoSampleMR::mr,
        dat,
        comparison,
        method_list = method
      )
    }),
    fill = TRUE
  )

  if (n_snps >= 2) {
    heterogeneity <- safe_test(
      TwoSampleMR::mr_heterogeneity,
      dat,
      comparison,
      method_list = c("mr_ivw", "mr_egger_regression")
    )
  } else {
    heterogeneity <- data.table::data.table(
      comparison = comparison,
      error = "At least two SNPs are needed for heterogeneity tests"
    )
  }

  if (n_snps >= 3) {
    egger_intercept <- safe_test(
      TwoSampleMR::mr_pleiotropy_test,
      dat,
      comparison
    )
  } else {
    egger_intercept <- data.table::data.table(
      comparison = comparison,
      error = "At least three SNPs are needed for the Egger intercept test"
    )
  }

  if (n_snps >= 2) {
    leave_one_out <- safe_test(
      TwoSampleMR::mr_leaveoneout,
      dat,
      comparison
    )
  } else {
    leave_one_out <- data.table::data.table(
      comparison = comparison,
      error = "At least two SNPs are needed for leave-one-out analysis"
    )
  }

  single_snp <- safe_test(
    TwoSampleMR::mr_singlesnp,
    dat,
    comparison
  )

  # For these loneliness/triglyceride pairs, TwoSampleMR will calculate approximate correlations if the harmonized data lacks r.exposure/r.outcome.
  if (comparison %in% steiger_pairs_stringent) {
    steiger <- safe_test(
      TwoSampleMR::directionality_test,
      dat,
      comparison
    )
  } else {
    steiger <- data.table::data.table(
      comparison = comparison,
      note = "Not run: binary-trait pairs are excluded from this Steiger pass"
    )
  }

  list(
    strength = strength,
    estimates = estimates,
    heterogeneity = heterogeneity,
    egger_intercept = egger_intercept,
    leave_one_out = leave_one_out,
    single_snp = single_snp,
    steiger = steiger
  )
}

### sensitivity results 5e-6
sensitivity_results <- lapply(names(tsmr_pairs), function(comparison) {
  run_pair_sensitivity(tsmr_pairs[[comparison]], comparison)
})
```

#### Forest Plot with All Four Methods (Relaxed)

```{r forest plot with all methods, echo=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

plot_data <- copy(sensitivity_estimates)

# Keep successful estimates and ensure the plotting columns are numeric.
plot_data[, `:=`(
  b = as.numeric(b),
  se = as.numeric(se)
)]

plot_data <- plot_data[
  !is.na(method) &
    is.finite(b) &
    is.finite(se) &
    se >= 0
]

plot_data[, `:=`(
  ci_low = b - 1.96 * se,
  ci_high = b + 1.96 * se,
  analysis = paste(exposure, "\u2192", outcome)
)]

# Display the four estimators in a consistent legend order.
method_order <- c(
  "Inverse variance weighted",
  "Weighted median",
  "Weighted mode",
  "MR Egger"
)

plot_data[, method := factor(method, levels = method_order)]

# Exclude AoU loneliness sensitivity comparisons.
plot_data <- plot_data[
  !grepl("AoU", exposure, ignore.case = TRUE) &
    !grepl("AoU", outcome, ignore.case = TRUE)
]

# Keep comparisons in the order they appear in the saved results.
analysis_order <- unique(plot_data$analysis)
plot_data[, analysis := factor(analysis, levels = rev(analysis_order))]

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)

p_mr_sensitivity <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = b, y = analysis, color = method)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high),
    height = 0.18,
    position = dodge
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.8,
    position = dodge
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", drop = TRUE) +
  labs(
    x = "MR effect estimate (b), with approximate 95% CI",
    y = NULL,
    color = "MR method",
    title = "Two-sample MR sensitivity estimates",
    subtitle = "All comparisons, at SNP threshold 5e-6"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_mr_sensitivity
```
- including sensitivity analyses, strongest evidence for:
  - Depression -> PanUKB Loneliness
  - Type 2 Diabetes -> Triglycerides
  - Triglycerides -> PanUKB Loneliness (to a degree, except MR Egger)
  - Depression -> Triglycerides also except for MR Egger which has a wide confidence interval

#### MR-PRESSO

```{r}
library(MRPRESSO)
```

#### Checking MR Results Adjusting for horizontal pleiotropy

```{r loneliness to depression, echo=FALSE}
run_presso_pair <- function(hdat, nb_distribution = 10000, seed = 123) {
  d <- as.data.frame(hdat)

  required <- c("beta.exposure", "beta.outcome", "se.exposure", "se.outcome")
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(d))
  if (length(missing)) {
    stop("Harmonized data are missing: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }

  # Use the same SNPs retained for your main MR, if this flag is present.
  if ("mr_keep" %in% names(d)) {
    d <- d[d$mr_keep %in% TRUE, ]
  }

  d <- d[
    is.finite(d$beta.exposure) &
      is.finite(d$beta.outcome) &
      is.finite(d$se.exposure) & d$se.exposure > 0 &
      is.finite(d$se.outcome) & d$se.outcome > 0,
  ]

  if (nrow(d) < 4L) {
    stop("MR-PRESSO needs at least 4 usable SNP instruments; found ", nrow(d))
  }

  # MR-PRESSO requires NbDistribution to exceed the number of instruments.
  nb_distribution <- max(nb_distribution, nrow(d) + 1L)

  MRPRESSO::mr_presso(
    BetaOutcome = "beta.outcome",
    BetaExposure = "beta.exposure",
    SdOutcome = "se.outcome",
    SdExposure = "se.exposure",
    data = d,
    OUTLIERtest = TRUE,
    DISTORTIONtest = TRUE,
    NbDistribution = nb_distribution,
    SignifThreshold = 0.05,
    seed = seed
  )
}

#loneliness -> Depression
presso_panukb_dep <- run_presso_pair(
  tsmr_pairs_stringent[["panukb_to_dep_stringent"]]$harmonised
)
```
